Select molecule ChEMBL ID, molecule name, max phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds reported in document CHEMBL5291721. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Filter by doc chembl_id CHEMBL5291721. Use LEFT JOIN compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles, allowing nulls. Return all rows without deduplication. Sort by molecule_chembl_id.
